h1: The 7 Best Lefant Robot Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Lefant Robot Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 7 best Lefant robot vacuums of 2026, from the budget M210 to the LiDAR M210 Pro OMNI and self-emptying M3.
summary: The Lefant M210 Pro OMNI is our best overall for LiDAR navigation, 20000Pa suction and a self-cleaning mop. The M3 gives a 90-day dock and hot water mop washing for less, the M310 Ultra brings ToF LiDAR cheaply, and the M210P is the one to buy if your furniture is low. The M210 is the entry-level pick.
intro: Lefant sells many robot vacuums with names that differ by a letter or a suffix, and the biggest buyer error is assuming a bigger number means a better robot. An M210P is a thin budget robot, an M210 Pro is a small upgrade, and an M210 Pro OMNI is a different class altogether with LiDAR and a self-cleaning mop. The model name hides large gaps in hardware.

We reviewed seven Lefant models and ranked them on paper by navigation, dock design, suction, mopping and price tier. The ranking uses listing details and owner reports, not bench numbers, and each pick is placed by what it adds or gives up against the model above it.

products.name: Lefant Robot Vacuum and Mop, LiDAR Navigation, M210 Pro OMNI
products.verdict: Lefant's most capable robot, with LiDAR and a self-maintaining mop.
products.description:
The M210 Pro OMNI lists LiDAR navigation with obstacle avoidance, 20000Pa suction, a self-cleaning roller mop with auto drying, an 800ml dustbin and 5G WiFi. Pricing sits between $200 and $500 for this one.

It ranks first because it offers the full navigation and self-maintenance set that the cheaper models skip. The M3 below it has a longer emptying interval claim but no LiDAR listed.

It suits buyers wanting Lefant's best. The caveat is that it is the most expensive Lefant here.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting Lefant's most capable navigation and mop.

products.name: Lefant Robot Vacuum and Mop, 12000Pa Suction, 90-Day Self-Emptying, M3
products.verdict: A 90-day dock and hot water mop washing without flagship pricing.
products.description:
The M3 lists 12000Pa suction, a 90-day self-emptying dock, a hot water self-cleaning and drying dock, and 5G WiFi with Alexa, app and iWatch control. You would pay somewhere in the $100-200 window.

It ranks second because it delivers the dock automation of the OMNI at a lower tier, but without LiDAR in the listing. The 90-day figure is a claim.

It suits buyers who want to stop handling the bin and mop. The caveat is that navigation is not described.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting a hands-off dock for less.

products.name: Lefant M310 Ultra Robot Vacuum and Mop with ToF LiDAR Navigation
products.verdict: ToF LiDAR navigation and a slim body at a mid-low price.
products.description:
The M310 Ultra has ToF LiDAR navigation, 6000Pa suction, a slim profile and a 170 minute runtime, with vacuum and mop functions. You would pay somewhere in the $100-200 window.

It ranks third because it gives LiDAR-level accuracy without the OMNI price, but it has no dock listed and weaker suction than the M3.

It suits buyers who prioritize navigation. The caveat is that you empty the bin yourself.
products.idealFor: Buyers who put navigation accuracy first.

products.name: Lefant Robot Vacuum and Mop, Upgraded 190° PSD Obstacle Avoidance, M330 Pro
products.verdict: Obstacle avoidance matters more than suction in a messy home.
products.description:
The M330 Pro lists 190° PSD obstacle avoidance, a 450ml visible dustbin, a 150 minute runtime and multi-floor mapping. You would pay somewhere in the $100-200 window.

It ranks fourth because its strength is avoiding cords and pet toys rather than raw power, and it carries no dock or LiDAR. The M310 Ultra navigates more precisely.

It suits cluttered homes and pets. The caveat is that you empty the bin by hand.
products.idealFor: Homes with cords, pets and floor clutter.

products.name: Lefant Robot Vacuum and Mop, 75-Day Self-Emptying, 6000Pa Powerful Suction, M2 Plus
products.verdict: Stop emptying the bin by hand, at a budget dock price.
products.description:
The M2 Plus lists a 75-day self-emptying dock, 6000Pa suction, a 140 minute runtime and 2.4G and 5G WiFi with Alexa, app and iWatch control. You would pay somewhere in the $100-200 window.

It ranks fifth because the M3 offers 90 days and mop washing for the same tier. The M2 Plus is the simpler dock option.

It suits buyers who just want a dock. The caveat is that mop care is basic.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a basic dock and no daily emptying.

products.name: Lefant M210P Robot Vacuum Cleaner, 4000Pa Suction, Super Thin
products.verdict: A super thin robot with a 200 minute runtime for tight clearance.
products.description:
The M210P lists 4000Pa suction, a super thin profile, a 200 minute runtime and app, WiFi and Alexa control. You would pay somewhere in the $100-200 window.

It ranks sixth because it is vacuum only without a dock or mapping detail. What it adds is the longest runtime in this ranking and a thin body.

It suits low-clearance furniture. The caveat is that no exact height is given.
products.skipIf: You want mopping or a dock.

products.name: Lefant Robot Vacuum Cleaner, M210
products.verdict: The cheapest, simplest way into Lefant.
products.description:
The M210 has self-charging, app and WiFi control, multiple cleaning modes and a low-profile design. Roughly $50 to $100 is what it asks.

It ranks last because the listing has no suction, runtime or dock figures. It is the lowest-priced pick in the ranking.

It suits small apartments and first robots. The caveat is that very little is documented.
products.idealFor: Small apartments and first robot buyers.
products.skipIf: You want documented power or mapping.

whatMatters.detail: Lefant uses letter and number combinations like M210, M210P, M210 Pro and M210 Pro OMNI for very different machines. Suffixes can mean thinner, stronger or an entirely different class. Read the bullet list for navigation and dock details, not the model number.

LiDAR measures walls with a laser to map rooms, while PSD sensors detect objects ahead to avoid collisions. LiDAR gives better route planning, and PSD helps with cords and toys. Check which one your home needs most.
Lefant lists 75 and 90 day dock intervals. These are claims for ideal use, and pets and carpet shorten them. Treat them as best case and check the bag or bin early.
Pascals measure suction force, and Lefant ranges from 2200Pa to 20000Pa. Higher helps on carpet and pet hair. Compare within the Lefant range rather than across brands.
Thin models like the M210P help with low furniture, but listings often give no exact height. Measure your lowest gap and compare it with the stated figure, if any.

howToChoose.intro: Floor plan and clutter level decide which Lefant makes sense.

cards.label: LiDAR
cards.text: A laser maps the room for efficient straight routes and saved maps. Picks here: the M210 Pro OMNI and M310 Ultra.

cards.label: Obstacle avoidance
cards.text: Sensors spot cords and toys ahead so the robot steers around them. Pick here: the M330 Pro with 190° PSD.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to LiDAR unless floors are very cluttered.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: Obstacle avoidance for accidents and cords, strong suction for hair and a dock or large bin to cope with shedding.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The M330 Pro has 190° PSD avoidance, and the M210 Pro OMNI adds 20000Pa suction with an 800ml dustbin.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want LiDAR and self-cleaning mop care, where the M210 Pro OMNI justifies the $200-500 tier.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You want simple vacuuming in a small home, where the M210 or M210P cost far less.

faq.a: The M210 Pro OMNI and M310 Ultra list LiDAR navigation. Other models use simpler sensing. Check the bullets before buying.

faq.q: What is the biggest Lefant buying mistake?
faq.a: Assuming model numbers rank quality. An M210P and M210 Pro are very different robots. Compare the listed features.

faq.q: Is the OMNI worth it over the M3?
faq.a: If you want LiDAR and self-cleaning mop care, yes. The M3 gives a 90-day dock for less. Choose navigation or price.

faq.q: How do I set up a Lefant robot?
faq.a: Place the charger by a wall, connect it to 2.4G WiFi or 5G where supported, and use the app. Run a first clean with doors open. Set schedules after.
Clean the brush, filter and sensors regularly and empty the bin or dock bag. Wash mop parts where applicable. Pet homes need more frequent care.
Higher suction models cope better, but check the listing for carpet notes. Mop models should avoid thick rugs. Test on a small area first.

finalTake: The Lefant M210 Pro OMNI is the best Lefant robot vacuum because it combines LiDAR, 20000Pa suction and a self-cleaning mop. The M3 offers a hands-off dock for less, and the M310 Ultra gives LiDAR on a budget. If your floors are cluttered, take the M330 Pro, and for tight clearance the M210P.
